decisionMakerNotice.subject: Determination Notice to Decision Maker - <decisonmaker>
decisionMakerNotice.content:
Hello ,

Attached you will find a summary of the recent investigation interview conducted. Please download and review this document for corrective and preventive action decisions.
There are five items to be considered when determining the appropriate actions to take as a result of the workplace investigation. Prior to making these decisions, it is important to ensure that personal feelings toward the participants do not enter into the decision making process. All corrective and preventative action decisions must be based strictly on the findings from the investigation. Consider the investigator's assessment and summary and then choose the appropriate actions.
Note that those items that are highly suggested and/or required will automatically be checked as accepted. Disciplinary action options are also included for the reporter, witnesses, and victim, to be used only in the case of a false claim or when false information is provided during the interviews.
Do not reply to this email. If you feel that a response you provided was inaccurate, please contact immediately using the contact information below.
